title: FIX THIS!
body:
After “bug fixes” there are problems. 
Widget doesn’t show todays date or month, it shows January. 
So I have a recommendation for you- don’t fix what isn’t broken.

title: No reminders
body: Unfortunately, even after playing the suggested settings, there are no reminders for most events. As reminders was the main/only reason to look into this app, makes it useless for this user.
author: RRichlv

title: Icons!
body: Having similar icons for different products is a terrible idea, yet new widget finally shows all day events whole day!

title: Very comfortable calander
body:
It is the most comfortable calendar I have ever used, I have even delete IPhone’s basic calendar. 
Improvement: would be nice if you add some new colors of events.

title: Smth bad happened to it
body:
I’ve been using and loving this app on my iOs but for the last month it has become unbearable - always slow and not opening new windows for tasks, events and even just to see the whole calendar. 
PLEASE MAKE IT GREAT AGAIN!!!
